# Genetic Branch

Oncolytic virus, CRISPR/base/prime, ASO/siRNA. Allele-specific targeting is real for *specific* drivers (KRAS G12x, fusion breakpoints, HPV E6/E7) — not "any mutation." Mostly ex vivo (allogeneic CAR-T with CRISPR knockout) or organs you can reach (liver); direct in-vivo editing of solid-tumor cells is not clinically achieved (blocked by the delivery wall). The sequence-level guide/off-target oracle lives in the paired **onco-target-design** domain — point there for guide design.
